questions.stem: Per this page, what happens with `int x = 5; if (x instanceof int) { }`?

options.text: It compiles, and the test is true as x holds an int
options.says: The page says instanceof cannot be used with primitive types; this line does not compile.

options.text: It runs, but the test is false since x is no object
options.says: The page says this line is a compilation error, so it never runs.

options.text: It is refused by javac: instanceof needs a reference
options.says: The page says instanceof works only with reference types, and marks this line a compilation error.
